description: Read-only prediction-market signals for a match (by id), a team's current-or-next fixture, or a date (default: today). Returns market-implied percentages with attribution; complete:false means the provider read was incomplete, not that no signal exists. Shown only before and during a match — finished matches have no market read. Informational only — relay the numbers factually; do not add betting, trading, or 'value' advice, and do not invent links.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today) for all that day's signals

flavor.description: Commentary flair: off, subtle, full (default: full)

lang.description: Locale for dates, provider attribution, and commentary: en, es, pt, fr (the summary scaffold stays English; other locales fall back to en)

team.description: 3-letter team code, e.g. MEX — resolves to the team's in-play match when one is live, else their next fixture

tz.description: IANA timezone for kickoff times, e.g. America/Mexico_City

name: get_market_signal

complete.description: False when the market provider did not complete every relevant read

title: Prediction-market signal
